wrong_claims.what_is_true: Porch no longer does; BuildZoom, Superpages, naicslist and hadaa.app do.

results.notes: Status re-confirmed: NJ licence #13VH02835300, licensed 2006, LLC in Middlesex County, Active through Mar 2027 (hadaa.app page read). No website of any kind found. Google Maps returns no listing for the name + 84 Riva Ave, and searching (732) 821-6354 returns 'Google Maps can't find' with an 'Add a missing place' prompt, so the no-GBP claim holds, while competitors (Broehl's Lawn 4.8, David's Lawn 4.8) do show rated profiles. Core gap and both build opportunities stand. Evidence lowered 4 -> 3 because the only profile the record leaned on (Porch) no longer exists, leaving directory data only.

results.name: Galis Photography & Video
results.notes: Record's North Brunswick town is stale: the site says 19 No. County Line Rd, Jackson NJ 08527 and the Google profile says 9 Broadway Rd, Freehold. https://www.galispv.com/ fails with ERR_CERT_COMMON_NAME_INVALID (cert invalid as claimed); pages are only readable over http. Raw HTML confirms title ' galis ' on every page, no meta description, no H1, no JSON-LD, a fixed 1600px absolute-positioned CoffeeCup layout (worse than merely non-responsive), a directions link to directions.doc, an mp4 over http, Vimeo iframe. Contact page: mailto only, no tel: link, and the truncated '(732) 534-411' next to the correct (732) 534-4011 - typo confirmed. Google profile shows 'Claim this business' (unclaimed), 4.1, address differing from the site. Only imprecision: robots.txt is not 'unfetchable over broken TLS' - it returns HTTP 404 (absent). Every top issue and opportunity evidence holds; scores left unchanged.

results.name: Rothblatt Law, LLC
results.notes: Confirmed operating but with a dead site: browser gets ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED and Google DNS returns NOERROR with no A record for rothblattlaw.com (domain present, no web host), so every click from the map listing is a dead end. Google Maps lists 'Steven D Rothblatt Law Office', 4.2, Law firm, 33 S Wood Ave, Iselin NJ 08830, website field rothblattlaw.com, phone (732) 448-1300, no hours ('Add hours'), 'Claim this business' shown - the Iselin vs 197 Route 18 South address conflict is real. Avvo profile is alive at 5.0 from 13 reviews and still lists an East Brunswick office, so the practice is active. No site, form or booking exists. Scores 5/3/5/4 read as reasonable; the record's rating is from Avvo/Bing while Google itself shows 4.2, a source difference rather than an error.

results.notes: Everything else checked holds: contact page shows city only ('East Brunswick, NJ' and 'Staten Island, NY', no street address); 0 script[type=application/ld+json] on home and contact pages; contact form has 20 input/select/textarea fields and no <label> elements for most of them; 'Meetings are by phone or zoom and by appointment only' present, no scheduling; tel: links exist in the header banner 'CONTACT US TODAY 732-637-9540' (two tel:+17326379540 links on the home page, none on the contact page); title/description name healthcare law in NJ/NY but no town; copyright 2026; at 390px the nav wraps to three lines with no hamburger. robots.txt disallows only admin/includes/config/logs/backup/.env/wp paths. Original scores (4/3/5/4) remain reasonable, so none proposed.

results.name: Patrick J. Richardson, P.C.

results.name: Irwin D. Tubman Law Offices LLC
results.notes: Verified: meta description is literally '-1837'; title is 'Law Firm - Bayonne and New Brunswick, NJ - Irwin Tubman Law' (wrong town); ld+json contains only WebPage, BreadcrumbList and WebSite - no LocalBusiness/Attorney; Contact Us page has 0 form elements and 'Email Us Now' is a mailto:info@tubmanlaw.com link; the header 'Call: 201-243-9700' is the Bayonne number on every page although a 732-254-1330 East Brunswick tel: link also exists. Google listing 'The Law Offices of Irwin D. Tubman, LLC', Family law attorney, no star rating or review count shown, owner photos present, hours shown (closes 5 PM). One detail the record did not capture: Google's address for the firm is 4 Auer Ct, East Brunswick 08816 (Williamsburg Commons), not the '530 Route 18' address the site prints - a NAP conflict worth folding into the listing-cleanup work. robots.txt is wide open with no sitemap. Scores 4/4/4/4 reasonable.

results.name: Nord & DeMaio
results.notes: Old domain confirmed lost: http://nord-demaio.com serves an unrelated Chinese-language site (page title carries a betting-brand name, body is industrial dehumidifier/humidity-control products and Chinese construction clients); https://nord-demaio.com refuses connection. Live site https://www.nordlaw.legal/ has title 'Attorney | NordLaw | United States' at /copy-of-attorneys and /copy-of-practice-areas URLs, 0 forms, only a 'Call Today' tel: link, nearly-40-years copy, three thin value paragraphs and no case results. Google listing is now named 'NordLaw', 3.0 from 2 reviews, Legal services, Metroplex 190 NJ-18 Ste 201, hours shown. Two nuances rather than errors: (a) a LocalBusiness ld+json node does exist alongside WebSite, so 'no schema beyond default Wix output' is borderline - the LocalBusiness node is present with name and url; (b) a viewport meta tag is present, yet the body is fixed at 980px, so at 390px the nav, hero and headings are cut off exactly as the record describes. robots.txt allows all and only blocks PetalBot/dotbot/AhrefsBot, with a sitemap. Scores 5/3/4/4 reasonable.

data_gaps: Porch pro profile for Denhard & Stuhl could not be inspected - the URL redirects to Porch's how-it-works page, so the archived 4.2/11-review claim could not be re-read from any page.

Google Maps' limited no-JS view does not expose review counts for every listing (Rothblatt's count, Gertsberg's count, Galis' count not shown), and 'Claim this business' status could not be re-checked for Gertsberg and NordLaw because Maps served an overview rather than the full profile panel.
Rothblatt's record cites Bing Maps surfacing Avvo; I re-verified only the Avvo 5.0/13 figure via search summary and Google's own 4.2 rating, not the Bing listing page itself.
Google profile review counts and hours for Denhard & Stuhl and Galis were read from the Maps result/place panel; deeper profile tabs (posts, Q&A, photos) were not opened.
